response.overview: Beltrán returns to the countryside where he grew up, searching for traces of a childhood he can barely remember. Together with a friend, he drifts through the landscape performing small reenactments and rituals, using play as a way to awaken memory. When a new predator unsettles the animals and disrupts the quiet of the countryside, the past slowly finds its way back.
response.tagline: The past is in the present tense.
response.title: A Body of Memory
